units.translation: where the scholiast says: ὁ Ἀρης κρίνει τὸ νεῖκος. οὐδὲ γὰρ ἄργυρον παρ᾽ ὑμῶν λαμβάνοντες εἰρηνεύσαιμεν ἄν [Ares decides the quarrel; for not even by taking silver from you would we make peace].

It is said mostly of the grip with which an athlete seizes his opponent, i.e. of the hold in wrestling or the wrestling hold, as Quintilian says, mentioned by H. Stephanus: whence it is transferred to other things.
Ares did not resolve the quarrel by a grip on silver.
to take equal grips in return
Ares decides the quarrel; for not even by taking silver from you would we make peace
I am insolent in speech, I speak boldly
rushing impetuously (thus Hermannus for λαβρόσσυτος) I came, subdued by the wrathful counsels of Hera
an eagle will violently tear apart a great rag of the body
the hare-born race of the wave
he learned of the hare-eating guides and leaders
(with perfect εἴληχα and aorist ἔλαχον) I obtain by lot
where λαχόντες [having obtained by lot] is corrupt. κλαίοντες (κλάοντες) [weeping] Stanley.
where λάχοιεν [they might obtain by lot] is more probable than λάβοιεν [they might take].

where Schuetz reads ἔλαχε δὴ τὸ πᾶν [he obtained the whole], others less probably ἔλαχε δ᾽ ἐς τὸ πᾶν [he obtained for the whole] (omnino, as Hermannus interprets). The scholiast seems to have read ἔλασε [he drove], who explains: ἤλασε δὲ εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῦ δρόμου, ὁ ἐστιν ἤνυσε τὸν ἀγῶνα · ἀφίκετο, φησὶν, εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῦ ἀγῶνος [he drove to the end of the course, that is, he completed the contest; he arrived, he says, at the end of the contest], which word ἐς τὸ πᾶν [for the whole] is more fittingly joined with than with the word ἔλαχε [he obtained]. Therefore either ἔλαχε δὴ τὸ πᾶν [he obtained the whole] or ἔλασε δ᾽ ἐς τὸ πᾶν [he drove for the whole] seems to be written.
as each of them, having obtained by lot, would lead his company to the gates
they stand at the gates, having obtained by lot
let them go, having obtained by lot
as each at the gates has obtained his lot
Capaneus has obtained the Electran gates
tell of another who has obtained other gates
I will tell of the one who has obtained the gates from there
yet someone else should have obtained her
the wave of Cocytus having obtained
so as to obtain an equal share
having obtained the land of Hellas by lot
so as to suffice well for those who have obtained wisdom
why do we not groan, not having obtained a share of the day?
but you revere bloody deeds, not having obtained them
for these obtained to manage all things among men
and may they escape the whole from the gods
the Pythian-chosen exile (Orestes) drove to the whole, urged on by the gods with good counsels
he drove to the end of the course, that is, he completed the contest; he arrived, he says, at the end of the contest
like a hare, having sewn up the fate of Pentheus
